query: SELECT managed_url.id, managed_url.sub_domain, CONCAT(workspace_domain.name, '.', workspace_domain.tld) AS "domain!", managed_url.path FROM managed_url INNER JOIN workspace_domain ON managed_url.domain_id = workspace_domain.id WHERE managed_url.id = $1 AND managed_url.deleted IS NULL AND managed_url.workspace_id = $2;
